description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to Property of intestate in Balagalla, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad Map No. 510006 and to 07 other Properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details for multiple properties. The content focuses on land title settlement and property inheritance claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
